description: Send Delco Plumber Now a request to contact the person about a plumbing problem in Delaware County, PA: their phone number and/or email, the problem and their town. Use only after the person has explicitly agreed to the consent text and provided their own details. Side effects: stores the request, emails Delco Plumber Now, and emails the person a confirmation if they gave an email; Delco Plumber Now may call them back (it texts only people who text it first). Not idempotent; limited to 3 requests per phone or email per day.

consent.description: Must be true, meaning the person agreed to: "I ask Delco Plumber Now (Andrew Furman, Aifurman LLC) to contact me about this plumbing request at the phone number and/or email I provided."

email.description: Email address (phone or email is required)

location.description: Town or ZIP in Delaware County, PA

phone.description: US phone number (phone or email is required)

preferred_contact.description: How they prefer to hear back; text needs a phone number

problem.description: The plumbing problem in plain words

name: request_contact
